batting.dismissal: c MG Johnson b R Dhawan

batting.name: R Ashwin
batting.dismissal: c AR Patel b KA Pollard

balls.text: and another one! what a shot, what an end to the innings! it was a slower one and he's been smacked over long-on for another maximum to get the Mumbai Indians close to 150

full-toss and that's been tapped for a six, now that's some serious power, it was almost a yorker-length ball and he needed move away, not too much of a swing of the bat and still hits it straight and long!
edged to the wide slip and almost carries but this time Pollard's rushed across for a very quick single to finally get strike
and another one bites the dust, four for Bravo, was shorter in length, the batsman was looking to run it through to third-man but gets only an edge through to the keeper

bouncer that and Malinga was looking to give himself room and crack it over the covers, beats him and it goes through to the keeper, umpire gives it one for the over but it's not quite over shoulder height!
edged and taken! he was looking to flick it away it but the ball does not angle back into the batsman, straightens slightly and the edge is taken well by Dhoni
fuller outside the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single
high full-toss outside the off stump and hit to long-on for a single

and now run-out, Pollard wanted to get back on strike but Dhawan gets run-out in the process, was hit to the leg side and they take a single, the throw is a poor one and beats Dhoni, but the fielder backing up is alert enough to throw it down at the non-striker's end

shorter in length and wants to pull it away, goes through to the keeper, there's an appeal by the keeper and the bowler but not given, cannot make out whether it's hit the bat or not, but the TV commentators seem convinced it is

that's fuller and wider and drilled to extra-cover for a single, that was hit hard and went quickly to Morkel who misfields, they want to come back for the second but Pollard stops mid-path and sends him back
on a good length and outside the off stump, enough for him to play it to the sweeper fielder to get a single and bring Pollard back on
and now it's drilled down the ground for a four! was a length ball and Pollard throws his bat at it, easily beats the bowler and the deep fielders there for a four

and now he's gone, 'four and out' has happened a lot tonight, and it happens again, it was fuller yet again and he slices it straight to deep cover where Hussey takes a straight-forward catch to send back Harbhajan

what a shot, that's timed superbly from Harbhajan, it was fuller, outside the off stump and he jabs his bat down in time and gets it through point for a four...Dhoni runs across to have a word with his bowler while Tendulkar stands up and applauds the shot
edged again and for a four too! it was an inside edge this time, he was looking to swing it away by stepping back, gets something on his bat and beats Dhoni to his left this time
shorter in length and wants to cut it away, was short enough too but quicker and beats the outside edge
edged through the slips for a four, it was a very full delivery and he gets some bat at it, and it eludes Dhoni to his right
slows it down drastically but that's gone down the leg-side this time and it's a wide

good change in length that, pushes it further up to the bat and all he can do is to tap it back to the bowler, the bowler threatens to have a shy at the stumps and Pollard invites him to do just that, ends at that
bouncer to Pollard but unlike Harbhajan he does not miss it, it was hit well through square-leg and rushes away for a four
and the bouncer is followed by a very full delivery, drilled out to the deep cover fielder for a single
bouncer and angling back into the batsman, he was looking to pull it away but misses the top edge of the bat

slower ball and that's been hit hard, or at least he attempted to hit it hard, the ball rolls away to long-on at a much slower pace than the bat's left the hand and gone high up in the air to where the short mid-wicket would have been!
outside the off stump, quite wide out and he has a bit of a throw of his hands at it, gets an inside edge back to the bowler
fuller, outside the off stump and driven to the extra-cover fielder who runs across to his right to stop it partially, the mid-off fielder tidies up to restrict them to one
and another slower one, he was looking to walk across to the off stump and is beaten by the pace, rolls over to the keeper
and that's hit him on the abdominal guard, it was a slower one, but gets a lot of bounce on that and Pollard's stinging, has a smile on his face though
punched back for a four, was a length ball on the off stump and he's smacked it back, Bravo was looking to get his right hand out but the balls touched the ropes by the time he's got it out!
shorter in length and slower too, was outside the off stump, and plays it down and through the covers for a single

bowled him, middle-stump sent packing! very full and very straight, this was the first ball after the time-out, he was looking to go down and drive it through the covers, sneaks through the bottom of his bat and slaps the middle stump low down
quicker, flatter and tapped away to the deep extra-cover for a single
he is bowling them very quick here, shorter in length and tapped back
shorter in length and he wants to cut it this time, gets it to the point region
that was wide outside the off yet again and he swings it away, gets a huge inside edge through to wide long-on for a four!
and not some deftness, it was flatter outside the off stump and he tries to play it through to third-man, goes straight to the fielder

quicker, flatter and powerfully smashed away to the sweeper region, Vijay had to run across about 15 yards to get to it, gets the dive in, stops the ball but it rolls away off the deflection to the fence
quicker, fuller and driven straight to long-on for a single
slower one but what's different about it is that it's on his pads, easily flicked away but not in the gap and they get only one
slows it down to 113.1 km/hr, waits for it and then taps it through the covers for a single
quicker and on his pads, beaten for pace, the extra pace I mean, and hits his pads, rolls over to square-leg and wants a single, is sent back by Rayadu and by the time the throws comes in, he's back
sorter in length and hes punched it through the covers, the ball races away to the left of the sweeper fielder and a diving Hussey does well to get to the ball and stop the four
under-edged for a single, that was a shorter delivery, one of the variety of deliveries he bowls and tried to play it down, gets an edge through to third-man
and now a six! tap, tap and smash! it was fuller on his pads and he swings his arms there, easily lofted over long-on for a six!
drives it straight to the cover fielder now and remains rooted in the crease
defended to the off side and he wants a single, sent back by Rayadu
shortens his length and cuts it through backward point for a single
slows the pace down a lot and is on the middle stump, turn away from the batsman, flicked away to the leg side for a single
shortens his length and changes his line to outside the off stump, slides it to backward point
on his pads and he wants to sweep it away, too far down the leg-side
continues bowling that favourite length of his from round the stumps, on the shorter side and without too much turn, taps it through the off side for a single
shortens his length for Pollard who gets back and cuts it through the covers for a single
length ball and driven down the ground for a single
shorter in length and taps it through extra-cover for a single
edged through the slips for a four, it was a quicker one and looks to drive through the line, some turn and beats Ashwin in the slips, through his hands!
shorter in length and on his pads, tucked away to deep square-leg for a single
the other one, carrom ball that spins away and defends to the covers
shorter in length and cuts it to backward point again for a single
shot that, inside out and just over the extra-cover fielder for a four, Raina was there and he had no chance of getting his hand to it
quicker and on the middle stump line, gets his bat and pad out, defended back
slows it down and on a length, not too much turn and tapped straight to long-on
shorter in length and outside the off stump, cuts it to deep backward point for a single
full and quick into the pads, but Rayudu can't work it wide enough of fine leg
a high full toss now, Pollard pats it down to long on
and he's away with a four first ball, but this is all timing, and little power, pitched up on off, he eases it past the bowler, mid off is up, long on has too much to do
gone, he's played on, Morris smiles, turns around and salutes towards the dugout, was a a pitched up delivery, angled in slightly, DK went for the drive, thick inside edge did the rest
outside the off stump, way outside in fact and it's called a wide
very short in length and he cuts hard at it, gets it to the point fielder, Jadeja fields it partially and the throw misses the stumps, Karthik was outside the crease when it passes the stumps
fuller in length this time, quicker too and he off-drives it but straight to the short cover in position
and gets back to bowling off-spinners, shorter in length and he cracks it through the covers for a single
leggie, that's on the off stump and its turned away from the batsman, beats the outside edge of the bat
fuller and flighted by the bowler, drilled down to long-off for a single for Jadeja to field
on the off stump line and tapped into the covers for a single
slows it down outside the off stump, tossed up too, pushes it into the covers for a single
on his pads and easily tapped away to fine-leg for a single

on a length and its pushed to the covers where Suresh Raina fields and has a shy at the non-striker's end, the throw's hit something at the side of the pitch, probably the microphone and jumped over Karthik for an overthrow
pitches it right up to the bat and there's a drive back, the bowler gets his hand out in time for it
and now Karthik wants to jump down the track but unlike Rayadu he looks to play across the line, beats the bat through to the keeper
and now jumps down the track and caresses it through the covers for a single, went rather quickly to the fielder
bouncer now and for a moment it looked like he looked like going for a hook, lets it go through in the end
shorter in length and outside the off stump, there's a backward point in place and he gets it past his left through to the deep fielder, third-man has to tidy up
on a good length and pushes it to the point fielder

takes a step down the track and taps it to the off side, the bowler rushes quickly to his left and has a quick pick-up and shy at the non-striker's end, DK's outside his crease but misses the stumps and they go for an overthrow
shorter in length and the keeper's back now, was looking to steer it down to third-man but misses
edged for a four! it was a quicker one this, 135.6 km/hr, he throws his bat at it and takes the edge of the bat, through the non-existent slips and for a four
slower one and on a length, he was almost through with the initial bit of his shot before having to wait on it and try and defend at it, beats the outside edge of the bat
short of length and he pulls it away to deep square-leg for a single
on the leg-stump line, cramping the batsman up with it, length ball too and tucked away to short mid-wicket

shortens his length and on the middle stump line, you don't do that when you have so many players on the off side, he gets a wristy flick going for him and easily beats the square-leg fielder through to the fence for a four
immediately gets it back to the good length and with a bit of an angle back into the batsman, gets his bat down in time and to the leg side
shot that, was slightly fuller than what he's been bowling so far, he goes over the bowler's head, smacked back to the fence
shorter in length and pushed through to fine-leg for a single
shorter in length yet again and he unleashes the cut, there's some bounce on that one and hit straight to the cover fielder
wide, short and gives it his full bat swing there, unfortunately for him, cannot find the gap and it's gone to the diving point fielder, fielded well by Bravo but they go through for a single
outside the off stump, and on a good length, steered down to third-man for a single
edged and that's a leading one that's gone through the region around the fourth slip, was a cross-seam delivery that, no-one in the slips this time and it's gone to third-man
fullish in length and drives it to the covers, straight to the fielder
shorter in length and brings it closer to the stumps this one and he defends it back to the bowler

what a shot, poor fielding but that's an excellent piece of timing from Karthik, much like in the previous over, he gets a length ball outside the off stump, punches it through extra-cover, beats two fielders including a diving Vijay who gets some hand on it but still goes through!
shortens the length yet again and he's left with no option but to push it to the point fielder
shortens his length now and he looks to defend it off the back foot to the off side, the fielders converge on it and prevent any runs
shorter in length and tucked away to fine-leg for a single
fuller on the off stump line and drives it to the off side, and off for a single

gone, gone, caught-and-bowled and that's number three for Chennai! short of length and on the middle stump line, he was looking to punch it back, the ball held back a little and it goes back low to Morkel who takes a straight-forward chance to his right, three down without too much on the board
on a good length and middle-stump line from Morkel and he defends it back to the bowler
shot, punchy one at that, short of length outside the off stump and tapped through the empty extra-cover region for a four
shorter in length yet again and movement away, just that slight one but enough to beat the outside edge of the bat, again
on a good length and outside the off stump, taps it to the off side, to the fielder
fuller on the middle stump and driven to mid-on, hit well but straight to the fielder

ooh, inside edge saves him! it was a big swinger back into the batsman, gets something on it probably and hits his pads, replays suggest could have been bat hitting pad. Probably the height saves him.
shorter in length and outside the off stump, waits on it before late-steering it through to third-man for a single
chips down the track yet again and again this over he gets beaten by the nip on that one, jags back into the batsman and gets some pad on it through to fine-leg for a couple
shoulders arms this time, was outside the off stump and on a length, trusts the bounce on that one
shorter in length and this seams back into the bowler, he was looking to play it to the leg side but misses, hits his pad and it was going down
on the middle-stump and angling into the batsman, tucked away for a single to open his account
shorter in length and outside the off stump, bit of nip away and the misses the outside edge through to the keeper

bowled him, what's happening here, it was very full on the middle-stump and he was looking to flicking that away to the leg-side, looked akin to that lazy elegance that Rohit Sharma shows while playing his flicks, except there was nothing elegant about missing the ball and seeing the stump flat on the ground, what a start for Chennai...
edged for a four! the slip was wide almost at the second slip slot and that's a genuine edge that's gone between him and the keeper, who's up to the stumps, rushes away for a four!
almost walks out of the crease and defends it back to the bowler

and he's gone now, a four and a wicket! this is a good ball this, it was on the off stump and jags back into the batsman, bit of cut from the wicket and hits him plumb in front of the stumps, was looking to defend at it
and this one is cracked through the point area for a four, was on a length yet again and just outside the off stump, he hits it through the line and gets it in the gap on the off side
on a good length and on the off stump, pushes it into the covers
short of length on the middle-stump line, tapped to square-leg and Tare wanted a single, but sent back by the batsman, the throw comes in from Jadeja but misses the stumps
smacked away for a four through wide long-on for a four which ends the game...
and that's been bowled quite wide outside the off
and a slower one this, was looking to play it across but the ball does not quite come on and it's rolled over to deep mid-wicket got a single
and a bouncer now at 120 km/hr, was looking to upper cut it over the keeper but misses
and again, that's the second one in a row, was very full and on the off stump, he's given it his all and smashed for a six
slapped across the line for a six to get to his half-century, too little too late
fuller and slower and driven down to long-on this time, not for runs
swings at it but misses, it's angling down the leg side and it's a wide called
very full, wide enough for him to tape it to long-on for a single
another yorker outside the off and another miss, he had to swing his bat at it but does not conect
very full and wide enough to get back down in time to tap it to the right of the sweeper fielder, they come back for the second
yorker length and he wants to heave it away, misses and it goes through to the keeper
and that's a pretty wide ball outside the off stump, noway he was going to get close to touching that one!
and now it's drilled through the covers, but straight to the fielder and expectedly the single is refused
fuller ball and outside the off stump, he has gone back and slapped it over the bowler, bisects the long-on and long-off for a four
and a bouncer to finish off the over, Mohit Sharma ducks under that one
outside the off stump and wide enough for the number 11 to let it go through to the keeper

gone, out, caught, goes down the track and he's chipped it straight to the short mid-wicket fielder! he was left with no option but to go after the bowling, he jumped down alright but never got any power on that shot and it lobs up gently for the fielder
was trying to slog sweep that one, fuller, outside the off stump and he's beaten, thuds into his pads
shorter in length and angling back into the batsman, flicked away to fine-leg for a single
fuller and slower and Ashwin's walked down the track, pushes it to the leg side for a single
shortens the length but no pace to work on that one, Dhoni guides it through to backward point but tell you what, they don't get a single
another slower one and this has been pushed through to the sweeper fielder, a single for the batsman who wanted a second but sent back
shortish in length and outside the off stump, he was looking to crack it away but the ball never came on to the bat there and the shot goes straight to the point fielder
shorter in length but takes the pace off it, he was looking to hit it hard through the covers, does not hit the middle and it rolls over to the off side
and now gets it outside the off stump, length ball, opens the face of the bat and guides it to third-man for a single
poor ball, a bouncer and way down the leg side, was looking to hook it away but misses by some distance, wide called
fuller on his pads, from over the wicket, flicked away to square-leg
and again jumps outside the off stump to play it, it's slowed down by the bowler and he can only push it to the leg side for a single
fuller from the bowler at the advancing Dhoni and he can only play it straight back to long-on for a single
and now Dhoni's done to Pollard what Pollard's done to many, it was on a length and gets enough room to swing it away, hits it hard, high and long enough for a six!
bouncer and he was looking to hook it away, but it's a slower ball too and the shot's played too early, goes through to the keeper and there's a loud appeal for a caught-behind by Pollard
bowls that one from wide of the crease and gets it to angle into the batsman, flicked away to wide long-on for a run
steps down the track and smashed it back to the bowler, goes on the bounce through his hands to long-off for a single
shorter in length and cuts it to the cover fielder
fuller outside the off stump and he steps out and drives it through extra-cover for a single
slightly shorter than earlier, wider too and he cracks it over the in-field, by the time the sweeper comes across they are back for the second
shorter in length, pushes it quicker too and he's played it into the covers, does not come back
shot, six! that looked six very early into the shot, gave him some width there and it was in his arc too, slogs it over the long-on fielder for a six
fuller from round the stumps and he pushes it to the long-on fielder for a single
shortish length ball and he is quickly back and tapping it to the off side, Ashwin wants a single but is sent back, has to dive back to get home...
slows it down and drifts down on to his pads this time, neatly tucked away to the leg side for a single
cut hard and straight to the sweeper fielder, it was a length ball and gave him width too, plays that one well but straight to the fielder
slower one and a shorter one too, he was looking to get some bat on it for a moment before letting it go through to the keeper
shorter in length again but this is on the off stump, pushes it to the off side
shorter in length and on the pads and wow, what a shot, that's just tucked away gently and it rushes away through the backward square-leg region for a four
quicker on the middle stump and defended back to the bowler
shorter outside the off stump, and turning away, wanted to cut it away, misses the outside edge of the bat
wants to smash it away, goes on the bounce to long-on for a single
edged to the off side, was looking to tuck it away but the leading edge runs away to the covers, does not take the single
slapped for a six! he will have to go for it and that's what he's done against Ojha, was shorter and flatter and flat-batted it over long-on for a maximum
quicker and shorter, goes back and taps it down to long-on for a single
and now he slows the pace down, goes back and taps it point for a single
flatter and pushes it quicker too, defended to the off side
fuller and on the middle stump defended it back to the bowler

out, gone, poor shot again and caught behind! it was a wrong 'un there, on a length alright and the batsman was looking to swing it away there, there's some bounce on that one and Karthik takes it well, I am not sure though whether there's an edge on that one, the umpire was quite sure though
fuller, quicker and on the leg stump, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single
shorter in length from round the stumps, tapped away to the leg side

bowled him, yorked himself there! it was full alright but Morkel was looking to give himself room there, by the time he's got his bat down, the ball's sneaked through and disturbed the stumps, Ojha's gone on a spin like he's gleefully test-driving a new, powerful bike
as very full on his pads and he was looking to paddle-sweep it around the corner, straight to the short fine-leg fielder
shortens his length and he pushes it down to long-off for a single, Dhoni did harbour thoughts of getting back for the second but they don't take a chance on Pollard's arm
flights it a little and it dips on the batsman outside off, gets some bat on it and pushed into the covers
slightly shorter in length and he pounces on that quickly, goes back and punches it to backward point, and then quick running allows him to get back for the second
round the stumps and on the off stump, no turn for him and only pushed to the off side
slower this time and on a length, he looks to run it down through the short third-man region but goes to the fielder
he continues pulling the length back and this is wider too, fishes his bat out and taps it away through the covers for a single
short of length again, this was not quick enough and he needed to hit it really hard to get it away, straight to extra-cover
tails down the leg side for a wide, it was a fuller one and swinging down
shorter in length and outside the off stump, punched off the back foot to long-off for a single
fuller on the leg side and driven to long-on for a single
short of length and on the off stump, not too much room for him and he taps it away to the off side
round the stumps and defended back to the bowler

fuller and tapped away to the leg side, they take a single but the shot's only dabbed slowly which allows them to get back for the second, the throw's a good one from Rayudu but the batsman's in by the time it came
gone for a six! that was slightly fuller and he throws his bat at it, did not seem to have come off the middle of the bat, more of the edge but it's still gone for a six, some power!
again tossed up from round the stumps and he has to wait long before getting his bat out to defend it to the off side
fuller outside the off stump and driven down to long-off for a single
slower in the air and floated up to the bat, he was looking to poke at it, inside edge to the leg side
continues peppering them with the shortish ones, it was on his body too and gets across to the off stump, manages to play it down to the leg-side where Karthik runs across to stop the single
goes back on his crease and plays a rushed stroke to the leg side for a single, was a fuller ball that
short of length and on the middle stump line, he walks across and taps it away to the leg side for a single

top-edged and gone again, Johnson has the last laugh as Vijay's been dismissed now! what are they doing here? it was short alright, but not short enough to play that stroke, was looking to pull away, almost swat it away, gets only an edge and spoons up easily for Rohit to take the catch
bouncer from over the stumps and Vijay sways away from the line, does that easily too and they exchange stares
short of length from round the stumps, angling back into the batsman and tucked away to the leg side for a single
shortens the length but the pace remains slow as ever, taps it to the off side and wants a single, Dhoni doesn't, Vijay takes a further step down the pitch but the captain sends him back
outside the off stump and opens the face of the bat and guides it through the off side

and he's caught at long-off now, poor shot this! was floated up to the bat and the batsman takes the bait, goes to hit it over the top but the fielder was a. on the fence, and b. Kieron Pollard, the combination is good enough to get Jadeja caught!
nice pace that, not too quick from round the stumps, was outside the off stump and tapped to the off side
fuller from the bowler and driven down to long-on for a single
floats it up to the bat and it's outside the off stump, defended to the off side

gone, caught, chipped straight to mid-on! that was another slower one and Bravo looked like he had read that one, was looking to flick it away but the ball never came on to the bat, the shot goes straighter than he would have liked, pops up for a simple catch to mid-on
on a good length and outside the off stump, pushed into the covers
edged and dropped! was short of length and he was looking to punch it down the ground, gets an outside edge and it flies to Karthik's right, gets his hand to it and it's spilled
slows the pace down and he tucks it away to deep square-leg for a single
shortens his length outside the off stump, Bravo does not get his feet moving there and was looking to guide it through third-man who is inside the circle, misses
and up and over the mid-off fielder, it was a fuller one that and he strikes it off the middle of the bat, the fielder at mid-off was running back and jumps up, does not get a hand on it
slows the pace down and he gets his bat and pad out to defend to the off side
goes back and whips it across to deep square-leg for a single
shorter in length and cracks it, hit hard too but it's not gone over the fielder as he was trying, luckily for him, falls short of Rohit at extra-cover
shorter, quicker, almost darted in and pushed down the ground for a single
and now it's shorter in length, rocks back and cuts it away to extra-cover for a single
goes over mid-on and smacks it for a four! it was a decent delivery but the mid-on was up, inside the circle and he jumped on that and smashes it away
on his pads and flicked away for a four, drifted down his pads and needed to get only some bat on it, does exactly that and gets a four!
fullish again and enough width there, but a cautious Vijay pushes it to the covers where there's an umbrella of fielders to stop it
very full outside the off stump, quite wide too at 139.9 km/hr and he taps it to the point fielder
slows the pace and down and that's been caressed through extra-cover for a four!
good shot but fielded reasonably well too, it was outside the off stump and very full, drives away from the body and a diving-Pollard gets some hand on it, Rayudu gives chase and pulls it in
short of a good length from over the wicket, angling away and tapped to the off side
shorter in length again but this one does not quite come on to the bat as he looks to go back and defend to the off side
on a good length but this is a slower one too, Bravo wants to hit it over mid-on but the slowness of the pace makes him play it late and get it over square-leg for a four, was on his toes too
ooh, that's some raw pace and bounce there, pitched shorter and it's at 144 km/hr, needs to hop away from the line of the ball
and now a yorker to Vijay, it was outside the off stump and he brings his bat down in time, taps it to the off side for a single
and another short ball, almost like it's a tactic against Bravo, looks to tuck it away but the rapidity of the ball beats the stroke
bouncer and had Bravo hopping there, bowled at 142 km/hr too and he manages to evade it in time, well bowled that!
short of length from the bowler but there's too much angle down the leg side, even if he wanted to get some bat on it, it was too wide and called so
on his pads and it's on a good length too, gets some pad on it to the leg-side for a run
down the leg side for a wide, was trying to bounce him there but it's drifting down
shorter in length and defended staunchly to the off side

edged and gone, three down as Badri's gone now! whoa, what a start for Mumbai, that was a poor shot from the batsman, wide outside the off stump and he was looking to play wide away from his body, gets only a nick through to the keeper
bouncer and that's angling away from the batsman, he was looking to steer it through to third-man and misses the outside edge, Karthik appeals but was missing
a touch fuller on the off stump and he gets his bat and pad out and tapped to mid-off for a single
short of length and outside the off stump, lets it go through to the keeper
